content: Rohan Deshmukh contacted Karan Joshi at Safe Step Insurance to inquire about a missing refund of $123.45 for a cancelled health policy, which was processed on September 24 under reference REF-2026-HP5678-001 but had not yet appeared in the customer's bank account after two weeks. Karan verified that the transaction was completed on the company's end and opened a bank trace request, issuing ticket number TCK-2026-00987, with an expected update within 24 to 48 hours.

action_items: Agent to email reference and ticket number TCK-2026-00987 to the customer
Bank to respond to the trace query within 24-48 hours
Customer to follow up if no update is received by tomorrow
